titles.romaji: Chong Qi Chengyin: Lu Shao de Xinjian Chong
titles.native: 宠妻成瘾：陆少的心尖宠

description:
Her vicious stepmother and manipulative sister never give her a moment's peace. After saving her from a desperate situation, the most powerful man in the city nicknamed The Living Devil falls for her and is determined to marry her. His name alone is enough to make her family and her scumbag ex-boyfriend fidget. Meanwhile, her love with the hero is growing deeper.

(Source: MoboReader Youtube Channel)
